ablation.name: brk_w_hf_wct
ablation.notes: Round 5 Direction 3: HF WCT (Whitening-Coloring Transform) on LH/HL/HH subbands. Math: AdaIN only matches diagonal covariance (mean+std), while WCT matches full covariance: f_w = Sigma_c^{-1/2}(f - mu_c), f_colored = Sigma_s^{1/2} f_w + mu_s. HF WCT captures cross-channel correlations in high-freq subbands, enabling richer texture transfer. beta=0.5 for conservative blend. Expected: DINO-S up (richer texture stats), CLIP-S neutral.
